Class Entity

java.lang.Object
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.entity.Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Renderable, fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.shadow.ShadowCaster, Comparable<Renderable>
Direct Known Subclasses:
FloorTile, OccludingEntity
public class Entity extends Object implements Renderable, fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.shadow.ShadowCaster
Represents a static object in a three-dimensional isometric scene. Coordinates can be integer or fractional, and the visual size can be adjusted independently using setScale(double).

  • Constructor Details

    • Entity

      public Entity(Sprite sprite, Orientation orientation, int xPosition, int yPosition, int zPosition)
      Creates a tile-aligned entity (legacy integer coordinates).
      Parameters:
      sprite - sprite to render
      orientation - orientation used to select the sprite frames
      xPosition - horizontal grid position
      yPosition - vertical grid position
      zPosition - height in grid levels

    • Entity

      public Entity(Sprite sprite, Orientation orientation, double xPosition, double yPosition, double zPosition)
      Creates a decor entity at an exact world-space position. The integer getters remain available for legacy grid operations; rendering, depth ordering, occlusion and shadows use the precise coordinates.
      Parameters:
      sprite - sprite to draw
      orientation - orientation of the sprite
      xPosition - horizontal grid position
      yPosition - vertical grid position
      zPosition - height in grid levels

    • Entity

      public Entity(Sprite sprite, Orientation orientation, int xPosition, int yPosition, int zPosition, double scale)
      Creates an entity with a custom visual scale. The scale changes only the image size, not the grid position.
      Parameters:
      sprite - the sprite to render
      orientation - the sprite orientation
      xPosition - the X coordinate on the grid
      yPosition - the Y coordinate on the grid
      zPosition - the Z coordinate on the grid
      scale - visual size multiplier (1.0 is the original size)
